answer: Every identity locks 20 POA for 16 epochs and signs 9 beacon-timed work receipts. A willow committee of 7 auditors replays 5 samples. Funding-linked member k must post 20*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 20*(2*k-1). The walnut ledger rejects a reused receipt; the fable ends with all cluster bonds burned and its keys barred for 14 epochs.
